# Mohit Sharma — AI Engineer & Full-Stack Developer

> Personal portfolio and writing of Mohit Sharma, an AI engineer who builds production-grade LLM applications, RAG systems, and full-stack products.

## Site

- Homepage: https://mohitsharma.co
- Blog: https://mohitsharma.co/blog

## About Mohit

Mohit Sharma is an AI engineer with 2+ years of experience shipping production AI systems. He specializes in RAG pipelines, agentic tools, and LLM-powered products, primarily using LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI, Gemini, and Groq. His full-stack background (Django, FastAPI, Next.js, React) means he builds AI features as complete products — instrumented, user-facing, and maintainable.

Contact: stayer.mohit@gmail.com
GitHub: https://github.com/mohitsharma012
LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/mohitsharma012

## Projects

- AyeFace Merchant Dashboard (https://mohitsharma.co/projects/ayeface): Rewards, referrals, store, and advertisement modules built on React, Node.js, Firebase, and Apache Kafka.
- CareerEdge (https://mohitsharma.co/projects/careeredge): AI-powered ATS-optimized resume generator using OpenAI, Next.js, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL.
- PandaUI (https://mohitsharma.co/projects/pandaui): TypeScript-first React component library optimized for SEO and Next.js static sites.
- Textberry (https://mohitsharma.co/projects/textberry): NLP text analysis API for summarization, keyword extraction, and entity recognition, built on Python and Django.
- PicShare (https://mohitsharma.co/projects/picshare): Real-time image sharing platform using Next.js, MongoDB, and Firebase.
- AlleyBot (https://mohitsharma.co/projects/alleybot): Contextual chatbot with sliding-window memory and sentiment-aware responses, powered by OpenAI.
- DevilsPlanet (https://mohitsharma.co/projects/devilsplanet): Full e-commerce storefront with Stripe checkout and admin dashboard, built on React, Node.js, and MongoDB.
